title: SourceDiscoveryReport
description: What a bounded research agent RETURNS — the candidate sources it discovered for a ResearchTask, plus the trace of what it did. This is the load-bearing point of the invariant: discovered_by names the agent, and serves_truth is pinned [false] — a discovery report is EVIDENCE about where truth might live, it is NEVER served as truth and NEVER promotes a canonical fact. Every candidate it carries must itself carry a source_handle. Baltor STORES this; reconciliation/verification decide what (if anything) becomes a fact. Deterministic when discovered_at is injected.

report_id.description: content-addressed over (task_id, candidate handles); version in metadata, never in the id

task_id.description: the ResearchTask this report answers (lineage back-link)

source_scope.description: tenant_private discovery stays tenant-scoped — it cannot seed a global_public fact

discovered_by.description: the agent id that produced this report (e.g. research.local_stub@v1) — the invariant requires an attributable, non-serving discoverer

candidates.description: the discovered SourceCandidate handles + brief authority notes; the full SourceCandidate objects are stored separately and referenced here

source_handle.description: every discovered candidate MUST carry a source handle — a candidate without a handle is not admissible

authority_note.description: the agent's note on why this source is authoritative (a proposal, not a ruling)

serves_truth.description: PINNED false — a discovery report can NEVER be served as truth (red-team: serves_truth=true is rejected)

trace_ref.description: opaque ref to the agent's run trace (steps/queries), stored, not inlined — replayability
